dialogue.content: こんにちは、今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for coming in today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you, I look forward to it.

dialogue.content: お願いいたします
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが始めてもよろしいでしょうか？それともジャスト開始がよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It’s a little early—would it be alright to begin now, or would you prefer to start right on time?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: That's fine.

dialogue.content: 始めましょう
dialogue.English: Let’s begin.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: It's a pleasure to meet you too.

dialogue.content: ニックネームでも構いませんのでなんとお呼びすればよいか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what I should call you? A nickname is perfectly fine.

dialogue.content: なおです
dialogue.English: Nao.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: なおさん、今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Nao, what brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 部下と上手くいってなくて、悩んでます
dialogue.English: I'm having trouble getting along with a subordinate, and it's weighing on me.

dialogue.content: 会社でのお悩みですねそれはお辛いですね
dialogue.English: A problem at work, I see. That must be difficult for you.

dialogue.content: 上手くいっていないというのは具体的にどのような事があったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you say things aren’t going well, what specifically has been happening?

dialogue.content: 最近なんか冷たい態度なのです。きっかけはわかりませんが、先月くらいから態度が冷たくて・・・
dialogue.English: Lately, their attitude has been rather cold. I don’t know what triggered it, but they’ve been distant since about last month...

dialogue.content: よく分からない理由で、態度が冷たくなってしまわれては困惑しますよね
dialogue.English: It must be confusing to have someone's attitude turn cold for no apparent reason.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 冷たくなる前のご関係はどの様な感じだったのですか？
dialogue.English: What was your relationship like before things turned cold?

dialogue.content: 4月に転勤してきて、3か月間は普通に接してたのですが、
dialogue.English: I transferred here in April, and for the first three months, we interacted normally, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 普通というのは、普通に笑顔で仕事を協業してました。
dialogue.English: By "normally," I mean we would work together with a smile.

dialogue.content: いまは笑顔がなく、淡々とといった感じです
dialogue.English: Now there’s no smile, and they’re just very matter-of-fact.

dialogue.content: そうでしたかそんな感じの方が急変されたのを一か月近くお悩みでお辛かったですね
dialogue.English: I see. Having someone change so suddenly like that—and you've been struggling with it for nearly a month—must have been very difficult.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ４月に転勤。というのは部下の方のほうですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned a transfer in April. Was that your subordinate who transferred?

dialogue.content: いいえ、私が転勤してきました。
dialogue.English: No, I was the one who transferred.

dialogue.content: なおさんが異動されてこられたのですね
dialogue.English: So you're the one who moved to this department.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 他の方との関係で気になる事はありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything concerning in your relationships with other colleagues?

dialogue.content: 特にはないです
dialogue.English: Nothing in particular.

dialogue.content: そうですかではその一人の部下の方の急変でお悩みなのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you're troubled by this sudden change in this one particular subordinate.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: きっかけが分からないのはとても気分が悪い事と思います
dialogue.English: I imagine it must feel very unsettling not knowing what caused this.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it does.

dialogue.content: なおさんとの関係。というよりその部下の方の変化は何か感じますか？
dialogue.English: Rather than just about your relationship, have you noticed any other changes in your subordinate?

dialogue.content: 冷たくなった気がします
dialogue.English: I just feel like they've become colder.

dialogue.content: 笑顔も消え、冷たくもなってしまわれてはなおさんもお仕事に差しさわりがででしまいますよね
dialogue.English: With the smiles gone and their attitude becoming cold, it must be affecting your work as well, Nao.

dialogue.content: そうですね、仕事を進める上で、なんかやり辛さはありますね
dialogue.English: Yes, it does make it somewhat difficult to get work done.

dialogue.content: そうですよねその部下の方との絡みは多いのですか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine. Do you interact with this subordinate a lot?

dialogue.content: 一番多いです
dialogue.English: More than with anyone else.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね毎日の事ですからそれはかなりお辛いことですよね
dialogue.English: I see. Since this is a daily occurrence, it must be quite distressing for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 部下の方にはその事で何かおっしゃられた事はないのですか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever said anything to your subordinate about this?

dialogue.content: 話してません、聞きにくくて・・・
dialogue.English: No, I haven't. It's hard to ask...

dialogue.content: そうでしたかなおさんお一人でずっと抱え込まれておられたのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been holding all this in by yourself, Nao.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その部下の方の豹変ぶりは皆にもですか？
dialogue.English: Is this drastic change in behavior toward everyone, or just you?

dialogue.content: いいえ、多分私にだけと思います。
dialogue.English: No, I think it's probably just toward me.

dialogue.content: なおさんだけですか・・・それはなおさらお辛い毎日でしたね
dialogue.English: Just toward you... that must make your days even more difficult.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: では、なおさんは転勤なされて始めはよかった関係が、この一か月で部下の方の豹変ぶりに訳が分からず毎日をお辛い気持ちでがまんなさってこられてきた。ということですね
dialogue.English: So, to summarize: after you transferred, your relationship was good at first, but for the past month, you've been confused by your subordinate's sudden change in behavior and have been enduring difficult feelings every day. Is that correct?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: その部下の方はご家族などいらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does this subordinate have a family or anything like that?

dialogue.content: 独身です
dialogue.English: They're single.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね部下の方には直接はお聞きになりずらかったのですよねでは、他の方にもお聞きになっておられないですよね
dialogue.English: I see. You mentioned it was difficult to ask them directly, so I assume you haven't asked anyone else either, have you?

dialogue.content: 他の人は気づいてないと思います。本人に聞いても、何も普通ですよ、と言うにきまってます
dialogue.English: I don't think other people have noticed. Even if I asked them directly, I'm sure they would just say, "Nothing's wrong, everything's normal."

dialogue.content: そうでしたか本当になおさんお一人で抱えてらして苦しかったですね
dialogue.English: I see. It must have been truly painful for you to carry this burden all by yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私の意見をのべさせて頂いてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I shared my opinion?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: なおさんは、ご自身が原因ではないかと思われていると思いますが、部下の方自身になにかあるのでは？と思ったのですが
dialogue.English: I sense that you might be thinking you are the cause, but I was wondering if perhaps something is going on with the subordinate themselves.

dialogue.content: そこはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: そこがよくわらないんです
dialogue.English: That's the part I don't understand.

dialogue.content: ご自身が原因と思われてるとお聞きになりにくいかとも思うのですが、そうでないとしたら、最近の様子が気になっているのだけれどどうした？とお聞きになれるのでは？とおもったのですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand it might be hard to ask if you think you're the cause. But if you consider that you might not be, perhaps you could ask something like, "I've been concerned about you lately, is everything okay?" How would that feel?

dialogue.content: それも考えましたが、たぶん、普通ですよーと言って、本心明かさないような気がします。そういう子なので。
dialogue.English: I've considered that, but they would probably just say, "I'm fine," and not reveal their true feelings. That's the kind of person they are.

dialogue.content: そうでしたかお考えになられておられてのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you have already thought about that.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ４月からの関係でよく部下の方の事をしっかり把握なさっておられるのですね
dialogue.English: You've gained a very good understanding of your subordinate in the time since April.

dialogue.content: ええ、一応長年働いてますので。
dialogue.English: Well, I have been working for many years.

dialogue.content: その子の事は以前から知ってましたし。
dialogue.English: And I knew them from before.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね転勤前からご存じだったのですか
dialogue.English: Oh, I see. So you knew them even before your transfer?

dialogue.content: 長年働いてるとはいえ、素晴らしい観察と面倒見の良さを感じました
dialogue.English: Even though you've worked for a long time, I can see you have wonderful observation skills and you look after people well.

dialogue.content: そうですかね・・・
dialogue.English: You think so...?

dialogue.content: 何もないですよ。普通ですよ。など部下の方が言いそうな事をしっかり把握なされてるのは努力なしでは出来ない事と思います
dialogue.English: Being able to anticipate what your subordinate might say—like "Nothing’s wrong" or "Everything’s normal"—is not something one can do without effort.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: その積み上げてきた関係が崩れたとなると本当に毎日お過ごしになるのが苦しすぎますね
dialogue.English: When a relationship you’ve built up starts to crumble, it must make getting through each day truly painful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: このお辛い状況をなんとか打破できないもんかと私も苦しくなってます
dialogue.English: I, too, feel pained, wishing there were some way to break through this difficult situation.

dialogue.content: すいません
dialogue.English: I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: いえ、こちらが良き提案も出来ず申し訳なくて・・・
dialogue.English: No, please don't be. I'm the one who's sorry I can't offer a better suggestion...

dialogue.content: 周りの人に相談してみようかと思います。
dialogue.English: I think I'll try talking to some of the people around me.

dialogue.content: こんな状況なんだけど、どう思う？とか、、
dialogue.English: Something like, "This is the situation—what do you think?"

dialogue.content: そうですね！ご本人の性格からいって無理であれば周りの方からはいい案だとおもいます
dialogue.English: That's right! If approaching them directly is difficult due to their personality, getting input from others is a great idea.

dialogue.content: なんか本人から来てる？とか、、
dialogue.English: Or, "Have you heard anything from them?"

dialogue.content: 聞いてる？？でした
dialogue.English: Sorry—I meant, "Have you heard anything?"

dialogue.content: そうですね！他の方ならなにかご存じかもしれないですよね
dialogue.English: Exactly! Someone else might know something.

dialogue.content: それに、今後監視して、なんか教えてもらえるかもしれませんし
dialogue.English: And, they could keep an eye on the situation going forward and let me know if they notice anything.

dialogue.content: 同僚に仲良しの子いますので、相談してみます
dialogue.English: I have a colleague I’m close with, so I’ll try talking with them.

dialogue.content: そうですねまわりからお聞きになられるのはとても良いと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think asking around is a very good idea.

dialogue.content: 今日はお話し聞いていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening to me today.

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: Yes!

dialogue.content: こちらこそお話しお聞かせいただきありがとうございましたはい、では他の方に聞かれ良き方向に向かわれる事を願っております
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your story with me. I hope that by talking to others, things will move in a better direction for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございましたまた、何かありましたらお気軽にご相談にきてください
dialogue.English: Thank you. Please feel free to come and talk anytime if something else comes up.

dialogue.content: はい、本日は有難うございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございましたでは、ご検討お祈りしております
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. I'll be wishing you the best.

dialogue.content: 有難うございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございましたでは、失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Thank you. Well then, goodbye.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: (今日はありがとうございました。いい提案も出来ず焦りましたがとてもいい学びになりました。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today. I was flustered that I couldn't offer a good suggestion, but it was a very good learning experience.)

dialogue.content: 頑張ってください！
dialogue.English: Keep up the good work!

dialogue.content: (はい！がんばります。ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (Yes! I'll do my best. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: (では、終了ボタン押させて頂いて大丈夫ですか？)
dialogue.English: (Okay, may I go ahead and press the end button now?)

dialogue.content: はい、お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: 本当にありがとございました。では、失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Well then, goodbye.
